data.name: Memory Gardener
data.detailed_description:
"Memory Gardener" is a top-down 3D adventure game. You will play the role of a memory trimmer in 2050, controlling the character to fight against the soldiers of the memory protection mechanism and explore the secrets of the future dystopian society.

You'll accept missions assigned by a company, engage in conversations with different characters, get to know them, and choose whether to erase their memories.

Pruning memory is not deleting, but carving a more perfect soul!

In 2050, thanks to the revolutionary brain-computer interface technology, all human memories are stored in the cloud, and the giant crocodile that controls this key - Memory Cloud Company - sends you to a border town as a new memory pruner. Your duty is to "heal", prune painful branches, and trim out-of-control memories, until you catch a glimpse of the bloody truth buried by the company in the broken memory wreckage. Every pruning is a moral choice

Erase the old soldier's war trauma... or keep the slum cleansing plan he witnessed?

Delete the girl's tsunami-like despair... or steal the deep-sea pollution coordinates she hid?

Silence the cult "prophet"... or crack the company's destruction agreement in his prophecy book?

Will you become the company's shield, or stab it with a dagger?

Eliminate the memory defense soldiers in memory

Every moral choice you make will affect the final outcome
